breakdown.description: In a spontaneous Zn/Cu galvanic cell, Zn is the anode and Cu is the cathode.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies Zn as the anode and Cu as the cathode, explicitly stating that the original incorrect assignment (Cu as anode, Zn as cathode) is reversed and wrong. It provides the correct electrochemical reasoning using standard reduction potentials to confirm Zn is oxidized (anode) and Cu²⁺ is reduced (cathode), fully aligning with the ground truth.
